summary: Frontend-only testing completed for AgroPlaza price comparison platform. All core features working correctly. App successfully refactored from e-commerce to price aggregator model.

minor_issues.issue: Some complex Greeklish words don't match (e.g., 'thermokipio' doesn't match 'Θερμοκήπια', 'zootrofes' doesn't match 'Ζωοτροφές'). Shorter versions like 'thermo' work correctly.
minor_issues.note: Basic Greeklish works (lipasma, sporoi, thermo). Complex multi-syllable words may need additional mappings in searchUtils.js

checks: Hero banner with price comparison messaging
Shows categories, products, popular searches, shops
Price comparison section with multiple store offers
Store offer cards with prices, ratings, availability
Outbound links have target='_blank' and rel='noopener noreferrer'
Products displayed with store count badges

action_items: OPTIONAL: Enhance Greeklish transliteration in searchUtils.js to handle complex words like 'thermokipio' and 'zootrofes'
critical_code_review_comments: Dead code: CartPage.jsx, FavoritesPage.jsx, LoginPage.jsx, SellPage.jsx exist but are not routed - can be deleted
searchUtils.js Greeklish mapping could be enhanced for complex words with multiple syllables
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a price comparison/aggregator platform for agricultural products. All e-commerce features (cart, login, favorites) have been removed. Search supports Greek and basic Greeklish. All data is mocked. Product pages show multiple store offers with outbound links.
